name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Senior Marketing Operations Specialist role. Your line about building the system rather than inheriting it describes how I've worked for the last several years. At Solenzo I design CRM and automation systems from a blank account: lifecycle stages, lead scoring and MQL criteria, routing, nurture logic, field standards, and the syncs that carry it all into the CRM.

The measurement side is hands-on too. I build GTM triggers and GA4 conversion events, enforce UTM conventions, and set up domain authentication and consent so the data is clean before it reaches a dashboard. I've worked in Salesforce at three companies, and I helped leadership at Accelo build their lead qualification system while carrying a quota, so I know what sales needs from an MQL handoff. I also use Claude and ChatGPT every day, including LLM API calls inside production workflows.

My HubSpot depth is in client builds rather than an in-house enterprise instance, and Clay and LeanData would be new tools for me. The architecture thinking behind them is what I do every day. I'd welcome a conversation.
